name: Optical and measuring instruments
note: For lenses, sights and other optical elements, and for measuring and checking instruments (pressure sensors, gas analysers, tape measures, squares, thermometers and the like), the CBP rulings in the pool turn on the facts. A lens took the origin of the country that milled or ground its shape; polishing and coating did not change it. Instruments mostly took the origin of the part that senses or measures: a sensing die or gauge wafer, a tape blade and reel, a scale engraved on the blank, or a board with its sensors. But a gas chromatograph assembled, programmed and calibrated in Singapore from a Chinese electronics box and oven took Singapore's origin, while die bonding, calibration and testing in China or Malaysia did not change pressure sensors' origin. No single step always decides. Standalone lenses and optical elements belong here; lenses built into a camera or display module belong with the display template, and medical devices with the medical template. Origin under these rulings says nothing about calibration standards, certification or any regulatory approval. Written from 9 CBP substantial-transformation rulings (10 kept by the D820 screen, 9 citable) outside the development and held-out splits (D820, D822), two of them also cited by the display template; every citation was read against its facts and held origin. Costs are illustrative defaults; users edit them.

groups.name: Lens and optical element shaping
operations: cut raw optical glass into blanks
mill or grind the blank to its shape, curvature and optical properties

precedent.note: Milling a riflescope lens's shape and curvature from a glass blank made Singapore its origin (N342427), and cutting raw optical glass and grinding and milling its curvature in Vietnam made Vietnam the origin of riflescope lens assemblies (N345937).

groups.name: Lens polishing and coating
operations: fine-grind, polish and wash the optical surfaces
apply anti-reflective or filter coatings, inspect and pack

precedent.note: Grinding, polishing, washing and coating in China did not change the origin of a lens milled in Singapore (N342427), nor did smoothing, polishing, centring and coating in China for lenses cut and ground in Vietnam (N345937).

groups.name: Sensing element or measuring scale
operations: fabricate the sensing die or strain-gauge wafer
make the board with the gas sensing element
cut and heat treat the tape, print the graduations and build the reel, spring and blade
engrave or stamp the measuring scale on the blank

precedent.note: Pressure sensors took the origin of the country where the sensing die or strain-gauge wafer was made, over dicing, bonding, housing, calibration and testing in China or Malaysia (N349940, N358288); a gas sensor board imported with its sensing element made in China, already able to measure, was Chinese (N335170); a digital tape measure took the origin of its tape reel, spring and blade assembly in each of three scenarios (N344318); a speed square took the origin of China, where its scale was engraved or stamped (N347948).

groups.name: Measuring electronics and display
operations: populate and solder the main and reader boards (SMT), load firmware and test them
build the electronics box or controller that reads and processes the signal

precedent.note: A wireless cooking thermometer took the origin of Vietnam, where its boards with the sensors, battery and antenna were made (N335017). The boards did not decide for a digital tape measure whose Vietnamese PCBAs went with a reel made elsewhere (N344318), for a gas chromatograph whose Chinese electronics box was built into it in Singapore (N340153), or for pressure sensors whose boards were fitted in China (N358288).

groups.name: Housing, body and blank
operations: mould or machine the housing, lid, tube and handle
cut, stamp and punch the metal blank of a square or rule

precedent.note: A Chinese tube and handle did not decide for a Vietnamese thermometer board (N335017), nor did cutting and stamping a speed square's blank in Vietnam when China engraved its scale (N347948).

groups.name: Final assembly
operations: assemble the sensing element, boards, display and housing
load software, calibrate and test the instrument
mount optical elements in holders, inspect and pack

precedent.note: Integrating the oven, electronics box and other parts on the chassis, installing the software, calibrating and testing made Singapore the origin of a gas chromatograph (N340153). Die attach, wire bonding, welding, oil filling, calibration and pressure testing in China or Malaysia did not change pressure sensors' origin (N349940, N358288); assembling a digital tape measure in China did not, when its reel was Thai (N344318); mounting Vietnamese-ground lenses with rings, spacers and O-rings in China did not (N345937).
